english.note: Use this colloquial expression for someone who has the guts to do something, especially before an action.

examples.english: If you’re gutsy enough, go up on stage and speak yourself.
examples.traditional: 你夠膽就自己上台講啦。
examples.jyutping: nei5 gau3 daam2 zau6 zi6 gei2 soeng5 toi1 gong2 laa1
